subject: firefly squid
title: A Squid You Can Hold in One Hand Lights Up a Whole Bay

scenes.text: A squid you could hold in one hand lights up an entire bay.
The firefly squid is only about three inches long.
Hundreds of tiny light organs cover its body, with bigger ones on its arm tips and around its eyes.
It lives deep for most of the year. In spring, huge numbers rise to Toyama Bay in Japan to spawn.
Their light looks blue, and the bay glows as it flashes in changing patterns.
They live only about one year. The glow is their final spawning run.
